positionNeedsNumber: POSITION takes a number from 0 to 99, e.g. POSITION 2 (0 for none)
roverQth: Add a break and set a new location?
roverQthConfirm: Added a break, now set your new location
catalogStart: Mark the start of the operation
catalogBreak: Add a break: what follows is a new segment of the log
catalogStop: Mark the end of the operation (also END)
catalogRoverQth: Rover on the move: add a break and set a new location
catalogOperator: Set who is at the key for this operation
catalogPosition: Set this device's operating position (0 for none)
catalogFind: Find a QSO in the log by number or callsign (also SEARCH, JUMP, GOTO)
